subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should Antigravity automatic selection always surface the most constrained exhausted quota, preserve the shipped usable-lane preference, or use different semantics for reset-focused and actionable percentage/highest-usage displays?
rationale: The current release deliberately prefers a usable quota lane, while this PR deliberately prioritizes exhausted lanes; source inspection and tests cannot determine which user-facing contract maintainers intend.

options.title: Use context-specific semantics
options.body: Show a binding exhausted quota in reset-focused output while preserving a usable lane for actionable percentage and provider-selection contexts.

options.title: Always show most constrained
options.body: Accept the PR's unified policy so exhausted or highest-used recognized quotas consistently win automatic selection.

options.title: Preserve usable-lane policy
options.body: Keep the current shipped behavior and decline the exhausted-lane reversal unless a separate blocked-family indicator is designed.

recommendation.title: Use context-specific semantics
recommendation.body: Show a binding exhausted quota in reset-focused output while preserving a usable lane for actionable percentage and provider-selection contexts.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner was explicitly asked to choose this permanent user-facing selection contract.
